contributions.statement: Gate agent PRs on diff coverage of the changed lines (e.g. JaCoCo plus a diff-coverage check), not on the suite passing, because existing tests executed only 61.5% of agent-changed Java lines and 27.0% of Python lines, and half of code-changing agent PRs added no tests.
contributions.evidence: §IV-A/B, Fig. 2: 213 Java / 1,664 Python merged buildable PRs; 64.8% of Python PRs had no changed line executed. Java subset is 10 smaller-than-average repos; no human baseline; Codex-dominated.

reason: Adds Java magnitudes showing that a green suite often never runs the agent's change, which justifies a diff-coverage gate in each repo's CI. The 86% try/catch figure rests on 43 Java lines and is excluded.
